page.overview:
Who is Chuck Berger?

Chuck Berger also known as the my-ding-a-ling boy. is a student seen in Lisa's class.

He is the kid that asked Lyle Lanley if the Springfield Monorail could outrun the Flash.

He was the kid who performed the my ding-a-ling in Lisa's Pony. He also has blue hair in this episode.

When Lisa's substitute teacher, Mr. Bergstrom, asked the students what their special talents are, Chuck shows off his ability of using the trick of inverting his own eyes.
